title-info.book-title: Tribulation of Myriad Races — Chapter 1147: Boss su yu (3)

section.p: Silverwing went straight to the point, “Let’s stop wasting time. This is not a safe place. Both Great Ming and Great Xia are not friendly toward us or your organization. What do you have in mind? Tell us about it.”

“It’s very simple. We need some cannon fodder and the intelligence network you have in the Human Realm. We’re new here so we have yet to build a sufficiently strong intelligence network. We need the cult to hand over the control of your intelligence network and spies to us.”
“That won’t be possible.” Silverwing’s face sank, “Are you joking?”

Su Yu replied coldly, “No. We only need some nobodies. The pavilion lacks a lot of things, but we don’t lack money. We’re only doing this to save time. If we wanted to do this ourselves, it wouldn’t be too difficult either. Ten drops of sunmoon profound yellow liquid for all that. This should be enough, right?”

“What joke is this?” Silverwing was furious, “Our current network has been established after hundreds of years of hard work. Not long ago, we suffered heavy losses because of the trouble you caused in the capital. And now, you’re asking to take over everything? Dream on. Do you think the cult is really so poor that we will agree to this?”
“You can only blame your incompetence for your losses. It’s not my fault you’re incompetent.”
“What did you just say?”

Su Yu coldly said, “You will only benefit from working with us. Officially, we have eight Invincibles. We are also the number one information peddler in the Myriad Realms. As for the Myriad Race Cult…you’re nothing but running dogs. Since you’re going to serve someone either way, why do you care who you serve? If you serve the pavilion, you will receive even more benefits.”
“Damn you!” Silverwing was furious.

Su Yu continued, “I’m a blunt person, so you should calm down. You’re a dog, but I’m a dog as well. We simply serve different masters. I serve the pavilion while you serve the myriad races. We are all dogs. But I’m a dog with plenty of heavenly source qi and sunmoon profound yellow liquid. How about you? Sect Master Silverwing, what have you obtained from the divine skywings for your service?”
Silverwing replied with a frosty expression, “If you continue talking like you’re better than us, there is no need to continue this talk.”

Su Yu smiled, “Talking like I’m better than you? Let me correct you. This is what I call a sense of superiority. Why? Because I have the Heavenly Hunt Pavilion behind me. How about you? If you were to die, would an Invincible from the six-winged divines do anything?” “It’s that simple. If I were to kill you here, the six-winged divines wouldn’t even care. But if you were to kill me, the backlash would arrive promptly. This is the difference between us. What do you think about my words, Respected Sect Master?”
Silverwing sneered, “You’re very confident.”

“That’s right. You can give it a try. If you want to continue the talk, we can do so. If not, I believe it won’t be that hard to find a different cultist interested in talking to us. You don’t matter.”
Silverwing was furious. This person was too proud.

Standing behind Su Yu, the other white masks also maintained their haughtiness. At this moment, they found themselves agreeing with Su Yu. Why should they be so polite toward these people? They were the members of Heavenly Hunt Pavilion. These cultists were nothing compared to them.

Even if this might result in their talks breaking down, they had to admit that it felt incredible to listen to Profound Nine. And feeling good was enough for them. If the talks ended up breaking down, so be it.
Silverwing inhaled deeply and suppressed his anger before saying, “This is not agreeable. But is this your sole proposal? List them all out. We can discuss all of them at once.”

Su Yu laughed and said, “Sure. I need some cannon fodder we can use against our potential opponents. Their cultivation levels do not matter. Additionally, I need some elites to work directly with us on our operations. These elites need to be Mountainseas and Sunmoons.”
Silverwing frowned and asked, “What’s your goal?”
Su Yu grinned, “Kill some people, some geniuses, some experts, and some Invincible descendants. Ultimately, we aim to snatch the Nanyuan ruin.”
“Hmph! Those are some big words, but they’re unrealistic.”

Silverwing did not take those words seriously. They wanted to do the same as well, but could they? Did these people really think that the Xia Family and human race were pushovers? Would they simply fall over and die just like that?

Su Yu said, “If you trust me, it will be fine. If not, there’s nothing I can say. The pavilion is good at creating chaos, but the cult is also good at this. The experts of the various races have arrived. Only by fishing in troubled waters can we become the ultimate winner. How else are we supposed to compete against all those experts?”

“The pavilion does everything for profit. The moment chaos erupts, our information, services, and products will become very popular. It doesn’t matter if everyone hates us. They will still be willing to pay us for what we provide. Am I right?”

Silverwing frowned. Shortly after, someone else from his side laughed and said, “Lord Profound Nine, allow me to ask you a question. The experts, geniuses, and Invincible descendants you’re planning to kill…do they include the myriad races?”
Su Yu replied, “It doesn’t matter to us. We will eventually receive such missions. That is not something you need to worry about. We are willing to kill anyone.”
“What if you end up attracting the attention of Invincibles?” The fatty smiled and said, “Don’t forget that Great Ming King is still around.”
Su Yu laughed, “He will leave soon.”
The fatty was the person who he had found familiar earlier. Thus, he looked at the fatty and asked, “Which sect are you from?”
The fatty laughed as well, “Original Devil Sect.”
Su Yu nodded, “Can you represent Lan Tian?”
“You can say so.”
Su Yu smiled, “So you think I’m lying?”
“I wouldn’t dare. But I’m feeling doubtful. If you don’t mind, could you tell us more? How are you planning to make Great Ming King leave?”
In fact, even the white masks were curious. How were they supposed to make Great Ming King leave? Was that even possible?

It felt impossible. Great Ming King had been staying in the Human Realm as of late. This was quite troublesome for them. Even with the tension at the border, Great Ming King remained stubborn. It was unlikely he would leave unless a war really broke out.

Su Yu said, “It’s simple. Great Ming is very protective. And the Zhu Family is quite small. The eldest child of their fourth generation, Zhu Hongwen, is currently in the Allheaven Battlefield. If he somehow ended up heavily injured, Great Ming King would definitely leave to avenge him.”
“Hmm?” Silverwing was shocked. “You…you’re too brazen. Nobody has the courage to enter the human territory and deal him a heavy injury. That’s Zhu Hongwen!”

Su Yu smiled, “We only need to injure him, not kill him. Great Ming King might be angered, but he will give up after failing to find the culprit. I don’t even fear Xia Family’s anger. Is there a need for me to fear the Zhu Family? As for the person who will do this…the pavilion will pick a suitable person to execute the mission.”

Su Yu continued, “Since you now know about this, if there is a leak of information, I will have no choice but to assume that one of you is the traitor. There is no guarantee that we might really execute this mission. If Zhu Hongwen were to suddenly receive the protection of numerous experts…it would only mean that there is a traitor among you. Sect Master Silverwing, remember everyone here today. If there is a leak of information, you will have to carry out a thorough investigation on all of them.”
Silverwing cursed inwardly. There was no need for Profound Nine to teach him something so basic.
Through his mask, Su Yu received a message from White One, “Profound Nine, are you really planning to do this? This won’t be an easy mission. There is no guarantee of success.”

“We can give it a try. If it doesn’t work, we can always switch to a different plan. No matter what, we need to send Great Ming King away. When he’s so near, it will be too hard for us to fish in troubled water.”

He added, “We can also take this chance to see if there are traitors among the cult. This will also be helpful for our future cooperation with them. Their member composition is too complicated. We can’t trust them too much.”
White One said nothing else. Clearly, that was not the only plan Profound Nine had in mind.

After a slight hesitation, Silverwing said, “If you can really send Great Ming King away, we can talk further about cooperation. As for our intelligence network, the price you offered is too low. Increase the price by ten times and we can share our network with you.”
“Ten times? That is enough price to buy all your heads.”
With a snort, a resounding boom rang out. The Mountainseas were all stunned. As for Silverwing, he raised his hand in panic to intercept the incoming fist. However, he was sent flying away.
“You—”

Su Yu pulled his fist back and coldly said, “Killing you won’t be too difficult at all. Ten drops of sunmoon profound yellow liquid are more than enough. Are you sure those small fries are worth a hundred drops of sunmoon profound yellow liquid?”
Silverwing took several steps back. The others with him did the same. They all glared at Su Yu furiously.

As for Su Yu, he merely laughed, “Calm down. That was a joke. But…you guys are really too weak. You’re only useful because we’re in a unique situation. Most of the time, we don’t work with Sunmoons so weak.”
“Damn you!” Silverwing was furious.
Alas, the pain he felt in his arms reminded him that he was indeed not Profound Nine’s match. Damn it! This guy was too strong! Just what stage of the Sunmoon Realm was this guy at?

Meanwhile, Su Yu snorted inwardly. If it wasn’t for the fact that it wasn’t appropriate, he would have killed this guy with one punch. The Six-Winged Divine Sect was the sect he hated most among the cultists. This was also the main force that had pursued Chen Yong previously.

At that moment, White One finally showed himself. Announcing his arrival with a laugh, he said, “Profound Nine, how can you be rude? Sect Master Silverwing, my apologies for this. Profound Nine has a bad temper. As for your intelligence network, we only need what you have in Great Xia. Fifty drops of sunmoon profound yellow liquid. I believe this is an excellent price.”
Silverwing cursed inwardly again. They were simply pulling a “good cop bad cop” on him. Did they think that he couldn’t see through this trick?
But this was not the time for him to further bicker with them. He snorted and said, “I need to discuss it with the others. You will receive your answer three days later.”
“One day. Unlike you, we’re very busy.”
Su Yu said, “So you guys need to procrastinate for even a small matter like this? I finally understand you guys have accomplished nothing even after hundreds of years in the Human Realm.”
Once again, the cultists were infuriated. This Profound Nine had a venomous tongue. They did not bother to waste more time here. With a flicker, they all vanished.
After their departure, White One said with some hesitation, “Will this work? You seem too forceful.”

“It will be fine. These are the people who have abandoned their race, family, and teachers for their personal benefit. Do you think something like this can really anger them? They are too shameless to feel insulted by our insult.”
Su Yu smiled, “They will only be angry if the price we offer isn’t good enough. Don’t worry. They will ultimately agree.”
Myriad Race Cult… As far as Su Yu was concerned, it wouldn’t be a bad idea to wipe out the cult once and for all as well.

Very good. The little furball had memorized Silverwing’s smell. That furball was even better at tracking than a dog. For these people, there was no hiding from him anymore. He would be able to easily track them.
Su Yu continued, “If we have to, we can even transfer more of our people here and take over the cult ourselves instead. As long as all their higher-ups are dead, the others will obey us.”

The white masks were rendered speechless. Was this guy serious? Was this a joke? Holy shit! Wiping out their higher-ups? If not even the humans were able to do that after hundreds of years, how was the pavilion supposed to do that?
Su Yu did not say much. As long as he could find their headquarters, this might really be feasible. It would also help in attracting more attention to Great Xia.
